prompt: How has Falcon (FALC) been doing on velocity and say/do over its recent sprints? I'm trying to decide how much to commit for next sprint.
final_text:
Falcon finishes about **32 points a sprint (10–11 items)** on average, but delivers only about **79% of what it commits to**. My recommendation is to **commit around 28–30 points** next sprint.

**Last 6 standard sprints (story points):**

| Sprint | Velocity | Predictability | Say/Do |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026.24 (Sep 30–Oct 13) | 34 | 95% | 85% |
| 2026.22 | 27 | 78% | 66% |
| 2026.21 | 38 | 100% | 92% |
| 2026.20 | 21 | 65% | 57% |
| 2026.19 | 31 | 89% | 80% |
| 2026.18 | 40 | 100% | 94% |
| **Average** | **31.8** (range 21–40, ±6.5) | **88%** | **79%** |

- **Velocity** is the points completed while in the sprint. **Predictability** is velocity divided by what was committed. **Say/do** is how much of the original commitment actually got done.
- I worked backward from velocity and predictability to estimate the commitments. They come out at roughly **32–38 points**, about 35 in a typical sprint. At 79% say/do, that means about **27–29 committed points get done**, and the rest of the velocity is work added mid-sprint.
- **Results swing a lot.** Strong sprints (38–40 points, about 93% say/do) alternate with weak ones (21–27 points, 57–66%). The weak ones are 2026.20 and 2026.22.
- **The trend is good.** The latest sprint was one of the better ones (34 points, 85% say/do).
- 2026.23 was an IP sprint, so it was left out of the numbers.

**Why 28–30 points:**
- It's close to what Falcon reliably finishes from its commitment, so say/do should land around 90% or higher instead of about 79%.
- It still leaves space for the mid-sprint work the team usually picks up, which is what pushes velocity up to about 32.
- Committing the full 32-point average would be about a coin flip given how much results vary. Going over about 35 matches the pattern of the weak sprints.

If you know of time off or carry-over work for next sprint, adjust down from there. I can also look at Falcon's backlog to check what about 30 points would actually include.
